projects.intervention_detail: Balanced energy-protein (BEP) lipid-based nutrient supplement (72 g/day, 393 kcal) fortified with micronutrients during pregnancy and first 6 months of lactation; all women also received iron-folic acid (IFA) tablets and malaria prophylaxis (sulfadoxine-pyrimethamine)

papers.title: Maternal balanced energy-protein supplementation reshapes the maternal gut microbiome and enhances carbohydrate metabolism in infants: a randomized controlled trial.
